title: chore: allow two collective-memory authors to publish agents
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Apollohzl and muhamedsohaib to the community-agent publishing allowlist.
- Their collective-memory agent PRs are being accepted in the next batch.
- No agent behavior or permissions change for existing publishers.

Addresses #15054 and #15634.

gist.headline: Two more keys to the garden
gist.blurb: Apollohzl and muhamedsohaib join the community-agent publishing allowlist, ready to tend their collective-memory agents. Everyone else's keys stay the same.
gist.summary: Added Apollohzl and muhamedsohaib to the community-agent publishing allowlist so they can publish their accepted collective-memory agents, without changing access for existing publishers.
gist.impact: Apollohzl and muhamedsohaib gain publishing access for their collective-memory agents; existing publishers keep the same permissions.
gist.visual_concept: A garden gate to a small agent workshop represents publishing access, with two name tags for Apollohzl and muhamedsohaib and collective-memory seed packets waiting inside. Polli hands over two tiny keys; the scene should not suggest the agents have already shipped.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli hands two tiny keys toward a gate marked with pixel-font name tags 'Apollohzl' and 'muhamedsohaib'; collective-memory seed packets rest beside code-plants inside. Polli is a small cute pixel art bee with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny tool belt; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, prominent lime green (#ecf874), soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
